component.name: TVGuideScene
component.script:
sub init() m.rows = m.top.findNode("rows") m.status = m.top.findNode("status") m.subtitle = m.top.findNode("subtitle") m.rows.observeField("itemSelected", "onRowSelected") fetchSchedule() end sub
sub fetchSchedule() m.status.text = "Loading guide..." m.fetcher = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ScheduleFetcher") m.fetcher.apiBase = m.top.apiBase m.fetcher.observeField("result", "onScheduleLoaded") m.fetcher.observeField("error", "onScheduleError") m.fetcher.control = "RUN" end sub
sub onScheduleLoaded() data = m.fetcher.result if data = invalid or data.schedules = invalid m.status.text = "No guide data" return end if dateStr = data.date if dateStr = invalid then dateStr = "" m.subtitle.text = "24-Hour Schedule - " + dateStr
nowSecs = secondsSinceMidnightET() content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") m.rowChannels = [] for each s in data.schedules cname = s.channel_name if cname = invalid then cname = "Unknown" cid = s.channel_id if cid = invalid then cid = "" thumb = s.channel_thumbnail if thumb = invalid or thumb = "" then thumb = "pkg:/images/icon_side_hd.png"
nowTitle = "off air" nowMeta = "" nowLive = "0" if s.videos <> invalid for each v in s.videos startS = hhmmssToSec(v.start_time) endS = hhmmssToSec(v.end_time) if nowSecs >= startS and nowSecs < endS nowTitle = v.title durSecs = v.duration if durSecs = invalid then durSecs = endS - startS nowMeta = to12h(v.start_time) + " - " + fmtDur(durSecs) nowLive = "1" exit for end if end for end if it = content.createChild("ContentNode") it.title = cname it.description = nowTitle it.shortDescriptionLine1 = nowMeta it.shortDescriptionLine2 = nowLive it.HDGRIDPOSTERURL = thumb m.rowChannels.Push({ id: cid, name: cname }) end for m.rows.content = content m.status.text = "^v Navigate - OK: Tune in - Back: Close" m.rows.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onScheduleError() m.status.text = "Guide error: " + m.fetcher.error end sub
function hhmmssToSec(s as dynamic) as Integer if s = invalid then return 0 t = s.Split(":") if t.Count() >= 3 then return Val(t[0])*3600 + Val(t[1])*60 + Val(t[2]) if t.Count() = 2 then return Val(t[0])*60 + Val(t[1]) return Val(t[0]) end function
function to12h(s as dynamic) as String if s = invalid then return "" t = s.Split(":") if t.Count() < 2 then return s hh = Val(t[0]) mm = t[1] suffix = " AM" if hh >= 12 then suffix = " PM" if hh = 0 then hh = 12 if hh > 12 then hh = hh - 12 return hh.ToStr() + ":" + mm + suffix end function
function fmtDur(secs as dynamic) as String n = 0 if type(secs) = "Integer" then n = secs if type(secs) = "roInt" then n = secs if type(secs) = "Double" or type(secs) = "Float" then n = Int(secs) if type(secs) = "String" then n = Val(secs) mm = Int(n / 60) ss = n - mm * 60 sss = ss.ToStr() if Len(sss) < 2 then sss = "0" + sss return mm.ToStr() + ":" + sss end function
function secondsSinceMidnightET() as Integer dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") dt.ToLocalTime() return dt.GetHours()*3600 + dt.GetMinutes()*60 + dt.GetSeconds() end function
sub onRowSelected() idx = m.rows.itemSelected if m.rowChannels = invalid or idx < 0 or idx >= m.rowChannels.Count() then return m.top.selectedChannelId = m.rowChannels[idx].id end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" m.top.closed = true return true end if return false end function
